# Raw List — verify raw file listing behavior

# Setup: initialize a KB
exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# --- Empty raw directory: list shows nothing ---
exec akb raw list
! stdout .

# --- Write a single file, list shows it ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write test.csv
exec akb raw list
stdout 'test.csv'

# --- Write multiple files, list shows all alphabetically ---
stdin ../data-input.txt
exec akb raw write alpha.txt
stdin ../data-input.txt
exec akb raw write zeta.txt
exec akb raw list
stdout 'alpha.txt'
stdout 'test.csv'
stdout 'zeta.txt'

# --- List excludes files.log ---
exec akb raw list
! stdout 'files.log'

# --- Write file in subdirectory, list shows relative path ---
stdin ../logo-input.txt
exec akb raw write images/logo.png
exec akb raw list
stdout 'images/logo.png'
stdout 'alpha.txt'
stdout 'test.csv'
stdout 'zeta.txt'

# --- Delete a file, list no longer shows it ---
exec akb raw delete alpha.txt
exec akb raw list
! stdout 'alpha.txt'
stdout 'test.csv'
stdout 'zeta.txt'
stdout 'images/logo.png'

-- csv-input.txt --
hello

-- logo-input.txt --
logodata

-- data-input.txt --
data
